morphology.pattern_note: 按外语植物名称整词处理，不拆为马来语词根或词缀。所列 IPA 为英式英语植物名读音；输入未提供马来语标准读音、音节或爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 欧洲花楸，学名 Sorbus aucuparia；蔷薇科落叶乔木，具有羽状复叶、成簇白花和橙红色果实。
senses.en_definition: A deciduous European tree, Sorbus aucuparia, with pinnate leaves, clusters of white flowers, and orange-red fruits.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis pokok daun luruh dalam famili Rosaceae, bernama saintifik Sorbus aucuparia, yang mempunyai daun majmuk menyirip, bunga putih berkelompok dan buah jingga kemerahan.
senses.nuances: 此处按英语植物名解释；更广义时也用于某些近缘花楸。输入没有上下文，不能排除其原本来自人名 Rowan；人名应大写并按本人读音处理。马来文释义为本条编写，未核实 DBP 收录；status 按指定结构保留。以下是植物说明中的自然搭配，不声称属于高频马来语词组。[American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=rowan)

etymology.historical_story: The English tree name rowan is of Scandinavian origin. Beyond botany, the tree became associated with protection in northern European folklore: people planted it near homes or used its branches as charms. Such stories concern cultural beliefs, not botanical properties. In Malay descriptions, retaining rowan alongside Sorbus aucuparia helps readers identify the tree without confusing it with unrelated trees called ash. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=rowan) [Woodland Trust](https://www.woodlandtrust.org.uk/trees-woods-and-wildlife/british-trees/a-z-of-british-trees/rowan/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rowan 的开头联想成英语 row“一排”：羽状复叶的小叶排成两行，枝头挂着一簇簇红果。此为记忆联想，并非词源。
